comment.narrative: For the Media Campaign RISE contracted the following to advertise for the media campaignJamaicas premier television station Television Jamaica TVJ3 radio stations IRIE FM ZIP FM and Nationwide News Network and Social media Instagram Facebook. Two slots on TVJ were used Prime Time News and Smile Jamaica a morning show with viewers as follows 794000 for Prime Time News and 350000 for Smile Jamaica. Radio stations Nationwide News Network confirmed 1755 listeners IRIE FM 330000 listeners while ZIP FM accounted for 166000 on the days on which the advertisements were posted while social media accounted for approximately 56000 viewers.In terms of traditional media The Gleaner and The Star accounted for 646000 readers. LOOP News CVM Television Jamaica Information Service and OUR Today carried aspects of the advertisements. These have not been included in the tabulation.Please note that a viewer watching the news may also see the same advertisement on the morning show. Similarly a listener may hear the advertisement on one station and when they switch to another station may hear the same advertisement or another in the package. In addition these media are available internationally hence it is not restricted to Jamaica.Total viewers 794000 350000 1144000Total listeners 330000 166000 1755 497755Newspaper The Gleaner and The Star 646000Social Media 56000TOTAL 2343755
